💡 NextSteamGame | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide game recommendations that explain the reasoning behind the similarity, focusing on intrinsic game characteristics rather than just player behavior.
✨ Key Features: • Semantic similarity-based recommendations • Hierarchy genre umbrella system • Vector similarity database • Metadata pipeline (Steam APIs, SteamSpy) • Review processing and quality scoring
📖 Summary: NextSteamGame is a Python project that builds a game recommendation engine based on semantic similarity and game identity rather than solely player overlap. It processes game metadata and reviews to extract detailed features, creating a richer understanding of why games are similar.
